title: Cattle alarm stays 0 while prose says the cattle already saw you
body:
On Exposed Ridge / Steading Yard opening, prose says the cattle already saw you and that cattle alarm starts at 1, but the **meter stays at 0** until a later DESCEND/feed.

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`, seed-base `1900000000`, store `ai-runs/playtest/grok-wave-200`): **22** reports in ticket `c565c8b7b45b73ba` (S2). Example seeds: `1900000042`, `1900000091`. Example record: `17d901d8edb5f3779110db61c51374b97af0b0db729881e2cfad9347512151a4`.

Fix: either start the visible cattle-alarm track at the value the opening prose claims, or stop claiming the cattle already saw you / alarm 1 when the track is 0.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave ticket c565c8b7b45b73ba (22 S2 reports) on build 36ff6d10.
